text_block_list.text:
Марузенски runs in the Radio Nikkei Sho
during
camp, and wins an outstanding
victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
When Марузенски returns to camp, she
is greeted
by an ecstatic Спешл Уик,
who has watched
the live broadcast of
the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Марузенски is pleased to see that her

participation in the race has had a
positive effect
on the younger athletes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
